baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated verb in `la yakhafuna` is directed to `al-akhirah`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fear is present anticipation of harm from a sign, while the latter or other horizon supplies the harm-bearing object whose force should reach the present.

activation_trace.role: Fearful anticipation of harm supplies the prospective affect negated by the focus construction.
That which comes later than the first supplies the consequence horizon toward which anticipation is denied.

changed_reading.before: They do not fear the Hereafter.
changed_reading.after: They do not presently anticipate harm from the later horizon, so its prospective force never disturbs present security.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object `al-akhirah` joins a root branch of postponement to the negated anticipatory verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal deferral is not merely the location of the feared event; it can explain why that event loses motivational force in the present.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear supplies the present response that a future sign would ordinarily produce.
Postponement to a later time makes distance itself a possible mechanism for the denied response.

changed_reading.before: They lack an emotion about a future life.
changed_reading.after: Their nonfear is temporally structured: what they consign to a deferred time is prevented from governing the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening warning and closing protection vocabulary turn fear into a functional relay: warning should awaken anticipation, and anticipation should place the self within protection. The focus diagnoses a broken relay rather than a merely missing feeling.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm is the focus response whose absence interrupts the relay.
Warning that frightens in order to awaken caution supplies the initiating signal.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the practical endpoint that fear should enable.

structural_cues: The surah opens with the imperative to warn and closes by naming God as worthy of protective awareness, with 74:53 immediately before the final reminder sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning that awakens caution and self-protection; I supply the arrow warning -> anticipated harm -> precaution. A live alternative is that fear remains affective and need not entail protective conduct.

changed_reading.before: They feel no fear about the Hereafter.
changed_reading.after: They do not let warning about the later danger become present self-protection; the warning-to-precaution circuit fails at anticipation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deferred horizon is concretized as a reckoning in which each self is held as a pledge by what it acquired. What is temporally postponed remains an enforceable claim rather than a remote abstraction.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation of harm supplies the present response denied toward the deferred settlement.
Deferral supplies the temporal distance whose apparent harmlessness the context reverses.
The explicit option of delaying supplies a same-surah enactment of postponement.
Acquiring sought gain supplies the personally accumulated basis of liability.
A document or object held against a right supplies the binding pledge mechanism.
Accounting and recompense identify the later horizon as settlement rather than vague futurity.

structural_cues: 74:37 pairs advance with delay; 74:38 immediately universalizes the self's pledge by acquisition; 74:46 names a day of accounting and recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delay, acquisition, pledge, and reckoning; I connect them as a deferred claim that matures into enforcement. The live alternative is that `rahinah` denotes general captivity rather than a juridical or commercial lien.

changed_reading.before: They do not fear a remote future event.
changed_reading.after: They do not anticipate the deferred settlement at which each self's own acquisitions hold it under an enforceable pledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene depicts bodies turning aside, distancing themselves, and fleeing a pursuer. Their fear is therefore not globally absent; it is displaced onto the proximal reminder while the genuinely later consequence produces no anticipatory response.

activation_trace.role: Visible manifestation of fear lets the preceding flight test whether the focus negation means total affective absence.
The later horizon contrasts with the reminder experienced as an immediate threat.
The reminder supplies the proximal object from which the depicted group recoils.
Turning one's side away supplies the first bodily redirection from the reminder.
Recoil and distancing supply the collective startle response.
Direct flight supplies the overt behavior that looks like fear in motion.
The pursuing force supplies the locally perceived threat around which flight is organized.

structural_cues: The focus follows without a scene break after the simile of startled animals fleeing a pursuer, and `bal` replaces their stated document demand with a diagnosis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning aside, recoil, flight, and pursuit; I read that bodily sequence as fear redirected toward the near reminder rather than the latter horizon. A live alternative is that the flight figures contempt or refusal without fear.

changed_reading.after: Their fear is misallocated: the nearby reminder elicits visible flight, while the later consequence elicits no anticipatory fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wish for each person to receive unfolded written sheets becomes a procedural condition imposed before response. The following correction and reminder expose this demand as a way to postpone the motivational force of an already available warning.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear is the response deferred while personalized proof is demanded.
Postponement supplies the temporal effect of the imposed evidentiary condition.
Being individually given something supplies the requested delivery condition.
Seeking a thing supplies the active demand rather than a passive lack of information.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the already shared alternative to private dossiers.
The written sheet supplies the individualized documentary form being required.
A published or unfolded writing supplies the demand for proof made fully explicit and inspectable.

structural_cues: 74:52 gives the group's stated wish; `kalla, bal` in 74:53 rejects and replaces it; 74:54 immediately identifies the discourse as a reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a desired individualized delivery, unfolded writings, and the correction that it is already a reminder; I infer the arrow procedural demand -> delayed response. The demand could instead be a direct expression of disbelief without strategic deferral.

changed_reading.before: They need more explicit evidence before they can fear the Hereafter.
changed_reading.after: Their personalized-document demand functions as a condition that indefinitely postpones response; `bal` diagnoses the deeper refusal to fear rather than an evidentiary shortage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier exemplar moves from resistance through internal thought and calibrated framing to bodily turning away. Nonfear can thus be an achieved posture manufactured by processing signs into a dismissive account, not a passive absence of alarm.

activation_trace.role: The denied anticipation is treated as the output of the earlier cognitive sequence.
Deviation from straightness and resistance to truth supply the sequence's governing posture.
Repeated movement of the heart over a matter supplies active internal processing.
Deliberative estimation and planning supply the controlled construction of an account.
Turning the back and withdrawing supply the bodily completion of cognitive refusal.

structural_cues: 74:18-25 is a narrated sequence of thinking, estimating, looking, facial reaction, turning away, self-exaltation, and a dismissive verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a singular exemplar's resistance-to-verdict sequence; I infer that it models how the plural group can produce nonfear by interpretation. The live alternative is that this one figure's process should not be generalized to every referent of `they` in 74:53.

changed_reading.before: They happen not to feel fear.
changed_reading.after: Their nonfear can be a manufactured achievement: signs are deliberated over, reframed, and turned away from until their future threat no longer acts in the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same numerical sign functions like an assay that yields certainty in some and exposes doubt or disorder in others. The focus nonfear is one diagnostic output of being tested by warning, not proof that the warning supplied no information.

activation_trace.role: Failure to anticipate harm supplies the diagnostic response observed after exposure to the sign.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism that reveals rather than merely informs.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies one contrasted assay result.
Agitated doubt supplies the unstable response against which certainty is contrasted.
Departure from health and balance supplies a condition disclosed by the same test.

structural_cues: Within 74:31, one assigned count produces certainty and increased faith in some while eliciting doubtful speech from diseased hearts and rejecters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit test and divergent certainty/doubt outcomes; I classify the focus group's nonfear as another resistant outcome of that assay. The alternative is that the groups in 74:31 and the pronoun in 74:53 are not fully coextensive.

changed_reading.before: Their lack of fear shows that the warning did not register.
changed_reading.after: Their lack of fear is itself a disclosed assay result: the warning registers, but their response resolves toward doubt and imbalance rather than anticipation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant diminishing branch of `kh-w-f` under the simple verb `yakhafuna`. It remains anchored to the exact focus root and gains a material echo from 74:28-29's no-remnant and destruction sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory lexical-material resonance, never as the primary gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root `خ و ف` can branch toward taking away or diminishing, while `الآخرة` supplies the terminal horizon.

activation_trace.role: Diminishing by taking from a thing supplies the outlier's attritional image.
The latter endpoint contains the projected process of depletion.
What remains after a process supplies the remnant that the verse explicitly denies.
Leaving a thing supplies the second denied possibility: nothing is simply left aside.
Doing away with or destroying a thing sharpens the attritional sequence into terminal loss.

changed_reading.before: They do not anticipate punishment in the Hereafter.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they do not reckon with the latter horizon as an attritional taking-away that leaves neither preserved whole nor abandoned remnant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatializes `al-akhirah` through its physical-rear branch, which is branch-distant from its ordinary temporal use. It remains anchored to the focus noun and is activated by night passing, dawn uncovering, and the advance-delay pair. Render it as a qualified spatial analogy for temporal inattention, not as a replacement lexical definition of `al-akhirah`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The `ء خ ر` noun in the focus carries a rear or posterior branch alongside its later-time sense.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation supplies the orientation that should project beyond what is presently visible.
The physical rear supplies a spatial image for the consequence placed outside the current field of view.
A phase reaching its rear and passing away supplies temporal movement through a posterior edge.
Removing a cover supplies the disclosure of what the preceding phase kept out of sight.
Advancing forward supplies one direction in the surah's explicit orientation pair.
Delaying supplies the paired motion that pushes consequence behind present action.

changed_reading.before: They do not fear a later world.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they do not anticipate the consequence stationed beyond the present phase, treating what is posterior as out of view even though the context pictures the cover withdrawing.

strongest_changes: Fear becomes the missing relay between warning and protective action, not merely a missing feeling.
The deferred horizon becomes an enforceable reckoning in which acquisition holds each self in pledge.
The flight scene reverses total nonfear into misallocated fear: the near reminder prompts escape while the latter consequence does not.
The request for private unfolded writings reads as a procedural deferral device rather than a simple shortage of evidence.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah sequence made the focus diagnosis functional and reversible: warning, assay, pledge, flight, documentary demand, reminder, and protection converge without forcing one final reading. Most distinctive is the contrast between visible flight from the near reminder and absent anticipation of the later consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The singular cognitive exemplar in 74:18-25 may not account for every member of the plural focus group.
The pledge image may indicate general captivity rather than a specifically juridical or commercial enforcement model.
The attritional and rearward activations depend on branch-distant images and should remain explicitly exploratory.
